brief:
An Israeli blockade is preventing Palestinians who have lost limbs in Gaza from accessing prosthetics and rehabilitation services they need, Middle East Eye reported. Omar Halawa, a Palestinian child amputee, told the outlet that his condition has deteriorated since the war began, describing his life as "worse than before the war."

The blockade has effectively sealed off Gaza's population from external medical resources and supplies necessary to treat the thousands of civilians who have suffered amputations during the conflict.
dek: Israeli blockade prevents access to vital care for Gaza's amputees "My life is worse than before the war," Omar Halawa, a Palestinian child amputee from Gaza told Middle East Eye.
title: Israeli blockade cuts off Gaza amputees from vital care
